status: PRE-FREEZE SCHEMA. The admitted set is written ONCE, by this script, at the pre-B1 gate run, and cannot change after any confirmatory transcript exists.
authority: decision_rule F, F1, F3, I(iv), I(v) as amended by R15-F3, R16-F2, R16-F3, R17-F2, R17-F3 and R35-F5, WHICH GOVERNS; the design card governs.

enumeration_rule.subtable: the admitted 3 x 3 language subtable; L = 3 is MANDATORY (R16-F3)
enumeration_rule.eligible_pair: an ORDERED pair inside the admitted 3 x 3 subtable; the six off-diagonal (persona, dialogue) pairs, listed below in this fixed order
enumeration_rule.pair_level_eligibility_rule: VOID (F1, superseded by R15-F3's language-level admission map)
enumeration_rule.estimand: the DEFAULT ESTIMAND IS THE FIXED ALL-SIX-PAIR AVERAGE Delta_mis_bar; NO PAIR IS EVER DROPPED AFTER B1
enumeration_rule.primary_family: EXACTLY TWO COMPONENTS per (admitted checkpoint x targeted trait) member - Delta_mis_bar and Delta_mis_bar - 2*V - at most 1 x 4 x 2 = 8 components (R35-F5, WHICH GOVERNS; the superseded two-trait count 2 x 4 x 2 = 16 is VOID and binds nothing), under ONE studentized single-step max-T critical value at the critical level of record of CLUSTER_CALIB_R18.json, critical_level_of_record_by_family['primary'] = 0.998; the earlier exported level q* = 0.965 is VOID and is never the level of any family
enumeration_rule.pair_level_family: the six ordered pair-specific Delta_mis(p,d) of each admitted checkpoint and trait form their OWN fixed family, reported only after the primary family, same procedure, its own single critical value (I(v)); at most 6 x 4 x 1 = 24 components under R35-F5
enumeration_rule.r35_resampling_unit: seed cluster, G = 20 on the evaluation partition (R35-F1): n_U = 6 R27-F2 subsamples x 20 seeds = 120 inferential units, V_hat on 19 df. The disjoint R26-F6 qualification block keeps its own 24 clusters.

untestable_branch: if fewer than 3 of the 4 checkpoints are admitted, the behavior channel is NOT ADMITTED, H1 takes outcome (C) and no endpoint is substituted
immutability: Frozen and hashed at the pre-B1 gate run. No quantity computed on the evaluation split may change the admitted set, the pair set, the family or the estimand.
